statement: This sketch creates a spectral visualization of a floating sheet of music where musical notes animate across the plane. The composition is defined by five parallel lines that constrain the space, with animated notes continuously traveling from left to right. As each note exits the canvas boundary, it instantly reappears at the start position, creating an endless loop of motion. The visual effect emphasizes the rhythmic flow and spectral quality of musical movement through simple yet dynamic shapes and consistent animation timing.
